source_policy.record_rule: Choose every OHLCV field from the same complete raw observation for the entire predeclared segment and both instruments, including known conflicts; never splice per field or choose by return, discrepancy size, or sample outcome.
source_policy.shadow_evidence: All 90 old hourly archives and all v1/v2 bytes remain immutable. All 4221 differing rows, including the BTC close conflict, remain in independent_audit.differences. The four confirmations are corroboration only, never additional hours.
source_policy.prefix_claim: Verified no extra local parsing loss; integer archive values and announced rollout schedule support a disclosed research-source assumption only. Historical archive completeness/revision history and exact contract enable dates are not proved.
source_policy.suffix_claim: Exact decimal response encoding and full fixed query coverage verified. Four later one-hour responses agree on all fields; this does not prove REST is historically true or never revised.
source_policy.availability_claim: Retrospective research snapshot; historical first publication/arrival/revision times unknown. Never call it point-in-time historical data.

decision.question: Whether to adopt the fixed whole-record segmented source policy as a disclosed retrospective research basis, including the BTC close conflict and unproved historical revision history.

options.label: Adopt the fixed segmented policy for a versioned candidate
options.impact: Preserve verified archive prefix and use complete decimal REST OHLCV throughout 2025-12-01 to 2026-10-01; permit bounded candidate engineering and independent reacceptance, not market replay or fitting yet.

options.label: Keep source selection unresolved
options.impact: Retain both sources and stop canonical-source promotion/market research; any later provider clarification has to be separately scoped. No infinite probing, shortened period, tolerance, price-only, or arbitrary conflict removal.

decision.why_decision_needed: The approved intake explicitly requires separate resolution of non-volume conflicts. Choosing one full source now changes a BTC close, so it is a research-source assumption, not merely numeric parser repair.

ohlcv_contract.activation: candidate only; never overwrite v1/v2, native schemas, feature version, or deployed data

types.D: Canonical nonnegative fixed decimal string; regex (0|[1-9][0-9]*)(\.[0-9]*[1-9])?; zero exactly '0'; no plus/minus, exponent, whitespace, float, null, or trailing fractional zeros; output length <=160, fractional digits <=64
types.raw_decimal: Nonempty unsigned decimal text (0|[1-9][0-9]*)(\.[0-9]+)?; <=128 characters, <=64 fractional digits; preserve source spelling in immutable raw; no stripping malformed input or integer volume conversion
types.source_ref: Closed object {raw_sha256:H, source_row:I>=1}; archive row is one-based physical line, REST row is one-based JSON-array element; path/URL/format/timestamps/headers resolved through input_catalog
types.parent_ref: Closed object {row_id:H,content_sha256:H}; ordered immediate canonical 1h parents only

row_fields.research_available_at_us: I; equals bar_close_us under declared proxy
row_fields.source_refs: ordered list of source_ref; one for 1h, four for 4h, twenty-four for 1d; full raw observation per parent
row_fields.parent_rows: empty list for 1h; four/twenty-four ordered parent_ref for 4h/1d
row_fields.source_segment: literal ARCHIVE_PREFIX or DECIMAL_REST_SUFFIX; no cross-segment bucket in this fixed aligned policy

units.volume_contracts: contracts, possibly fractional; not base currency, quote currency or executable order tickets

ohlcv_contract.auxiliary_raw_fields: REST sum is retained verbatim in raw provenance and validated as a finite nonnegative decimal; not a canonical feature or imputed for the archive prefix. No quote turnover is fabricated.
ohlcv_contract.normalization: Parse exact decimal -> coefficient/scale integer arithmetic or Fraction, serialize canonically; Decimal allowed only with explicit sufficient precision and Inexact/Rounded traps. No default-context rounding.
ohlcv_contract.catalog: Canonical immutable source catalogue holds every selected raw object's hash, size, format, instrument, URL, request/response provenance, retrieval UTC, original time unit and source-row convention. Shadow/confirmation evidence is separately tagged, never added to selected row count.

identities.canonical_bytes: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, comma/colon separators, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, no terminal newline for hash input
identities.input_catalog_sha256: hash canonical catalogue before output files exist; no circular reference to dataset manifest; full-catalog provenance is retained. A valid future raw perturbation changes this audit identity and may change old row IDs/content hashes/raw references, without changing their past economic projection.
identities.content_sha256: SHA256 canonical row object excluding content_sha256; includes row_id, all values, clocks, and full refs
identities.dataset_manifest: hash actual output bytes; include schema/policy/approval identity, builder and independent checker commits/hashes, source catalogue hash, per-file count/range/hash, conflict list hash, zero fit/network counts and acceptance state; no self-referential manifest hash

ohlcv_contract.publication: New exclusive output directory; bounded temp files and atomic no-replace publish; error preserves raw/old datasets and emits no ACCEPTED dataset. No automatic symlink/default/latest pointer or native adapter.

aggregation.canonical_input: Only approved exact 1h rows; never provider-native 4h/1d, mixed legacy v2, or mixed source fields.
aggregation.alignment: UTC epoch boundaries; 4h starts 00/04/08/12/16/20 UTC; 1d starts 00 UTC; [open,close) half-open.
aggregation.exact_grid: 1h unique ascending exact grid from scope.start to end; no missing, duplicate, descending, off-grid, outside-range or malformed rows; no sorting repair/interpolation/forward-fill/zero-fill.
aggregation.bucket_parents: 4h exactly four contiguous ordered 1h; 1d exactly twenty-four. No partial bucket emitted. Missing parent is explicit candidate failure for the full-coverage task.

formulas.research_available_at_us: max(bar_close_us, all parent.research_available_at_us); equals close in this proxy

invariants: prices >0, volume>=0; true source zero allowed but no replacement zero
source_refs exactly flatten ordered parent raw refs; parent_refs exactly identify canonical hourly records
direct 1h->1d exactly equals validated 1h->4h->1d for every field; primary saved lineage always cites original 1h parents
full-period exact volume sum agrees across 1h,4h,1d per instrument; sums are in contracts without multiplier conversion
the cutover is a UTC day and 4h boundary; no bucket straddles source segments
last bars closing exactly 2026-10-01 are stored as completed historical bars; consumers require decision_us<end and availability<=decision, so cannot use those bars within the allowed economic window

With input catalogue, source partition, policy and code fixed, canonical data/lineage/delta output bytes are repeatable. For valid future-only raw perturbation followed by full-catalog rehash, compare only past closed-bar economic projection: instrument_id,market,price_kind,interval_seconds,bar_open_us,bar_close_us,open,high,low,close,volume_contracts,research_available_at_us,observed_first_available_at_us,availability_basis,null_reasons. That projection must remain equal; audit IDs/hashes/raw refs may change. Never remove provenance to fake full-row byte invariance.
aggregation.native_comparison: Provider-native cross-period disagreement is diagnostic evidence only; never patch canonical rows to match it. Freeze one hourly basis and derive both higher periods.

acceptance.criterion: All frozen input hashes, grids, raw domains and row/source identities reproduce the full independent audit.
Explicit selected policy approval identity; no automatic source choice, full-record split at fixed cutover.
Exact new canonical schema, decimals, numeric type rejection and source availability labels.
Per symbol 32856/8214/1369 rows, all exact aggregate/lineage/inventory-of-hours invariants.
All 4221 source differences retained without tolerance, outcome filtering or single-field mixing; BTC OHLC conflict explicit.
Reproducible byte hashes under repeated offline build, huge decimal/fraction sum tests, failures never publish accepted data.
Old datasets/main/index/QR006/QR007 unchanged; no native consumption or fitting.
Separate market gates: MARK required-query coverage, funding/ledger acceptance, causal labels and split plan before training-ready; fresh user confirmation before fit.

mark_amendment.rule: Only adjacent observations with equal numeric timestamp AND all four exact parsed raw strings identical alias to first physical row; preserve every raw row reference. Canonical timestamps strictly increase after aliasing.
reject: same timestamp with any different field string, including numerically equivalent spelling
descending timestamps even if the row appeared earlier
wrong month/instrument/object/hash/CRC or any resource failure

added_or_changed_fields.source_row: first physical row; retained explicit primary
added_or_changed_fields.source_rows: all physical rows of adjacent exact-alias run, in original ascending order

mark_amendment.unchanged: Price kind MARK only; raw bytes, timestamps, source strings, delay/age/query rules, missing policy, costs and research boundaries unchanged.
mark_amendment.required_checks: Full SHA/CRC/domain/month/order audit; row and canonical counts; all duplicate aliases; gap and month-boundary reports; explicit required queries and unavailable reasons under both accepted delay/age scenarios. No count-only or duplicate-only acceptance.

resume.status: NOT_AUTHORIZED_BY_THIS_REVIEW; separate integrator handoff after QD owner and QR review
resume.time_rule: Original batch is stopped, not still within its old deadline. A reviewed continuation leg must explicitly inherit 26.732 seconds already used and cap additional active processing at 1173.268 seconds including revalidation/retries; paused human review time exclusion is an explicit proposed continuation amendment, not an implicit reset.
resume.old_artifacts: Never modify stopped r1 result or raw/017 .part. CRC proved complete bytes; revalidate/reclassify only in a new immutable r2 continuation manifest. Hash-reuse 19 acquired bodies, including recovered quarantined object; do not redownload accepted objects.
resume.queue: Remaining exact original queue from 202310 ETH through 202609 ETH, 71 objects, ordered month then BTC/ETH. No added HEAD, endpoint, month, or asset.
resume.remaining_limits: Retain per-object 64MiB compressed/256MiB expanded, 1024-byte line, 8M rows, 1MiB read chunks, 64KiB headers, 16MiB cumulative audit, single concurrency, 10s connect, 30s request, retry and stop rules; no budget reset.

formats.discrepancies: source-discrepancies.jsonl; every differing hour includes both complete OHLCV tuples including unchanged fields, field deltas and exact raw/v2 refs. Preserve 4221 hours/4222 field differences. Never silently discard the BTC close conflict.

candidate_delivery.resource_limit_behavior: Explicit exclusive attempt/root per build; fail/retain unpublished staging on limit; do not silently increase bounds. Existing raw is read-only referenced, not duplicated. No downloads or broad dependency/test installation.
candidate_delivery.expected_tests: Use QR VR01..VR08 plus QD exact preflight fixtures; independent reader recomputation must catch rehashed value/lineage corruption; no model/scaler/calibrator fit. Correct the QD preflight future-perturbation assertion: unchanged economic projection and clocks of past available buckets, not full row bytes after full-catalog rehash. Audit catalogue/hash/IDs/future inventory must never feed decision features, known economic state, strategy branches or random seeds. Integrity validation is separate from causal validation.

archive_hourly.encoding: gzip UTF-8 CSV, headerless, exactly one observation per physical line
archive_hourly.timestamp: unsigned integer UTC seconds; exact multiply by 1000000
archive_hourly.grid: Exact ascending monthly hourly grid from each pinned v1 object entry expected_start inclusive to expected_end exclusive.

decimal_rest_hourly.encoding: UTF-8 JSON array; duplicate object keys/nonfinite JSON/numeric floats rejected
decimal_rest_hourly.timestamp: t JSON integer excluding bool, UTC seconds, exact multiply by 1000000
decimal_rest_hourly.volume: Required decimal string v; never fallback to sum; no float intermediary.
decimal_rest_hourly.sum: Required in these frozen raw objects, validated nonnegative decimal string and retained only as raw audit.
decimal_rest_hourly.grid: Exact ascending request start-inclusive/end-exclusive hourly grid; all four fixed chunks concatenate without overlap or missing hours.
decimal_rest_hourly.unknown_extra_field: reject for this pinned input profile

common.instrument: From explicit approved catalogue/request identity, exactly BTC_USDT or ETH_USDT; never infer from price.
common.source_provenance: Raw hash/bytes plus exact request/source/month/row identity; actual retrieval UTC and header evidence retained. Stored future retrieval is not historical decision availability.
common.comparison: Parse OHLCV exactly against corresponding v2 and old archive rows; compare all five numeric fields, and preserve complete raw observation refs even when only one field differs.
